name: Scribe
description: Scribe is a process-documentation platform that turns captured work into step-by-step guides with screenshots. Organizations use it to publish SOPs, organize knowledge, explore business workflows, and identify process improvements.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Scribe OAuth, then let agents search and retrieve permitted documents, workflows, and optimization insights through Scribe's hosted MCP.

capabilities.label: Search and read process knowledge
capabilities.description: Search and retrieve permitted Scribe documents, pages, teams, and screenshots.

capabilities.label: Explore workflows and insights
capabilities.description: Explore permitted workflow hierarchies, execution history, friction points, and optimization recommendations.

allowed.label: Read Scribe knowledge
allowed.description: Use one live-discovered, non-mutating Scribe MCP tool with bounded arguments.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Live-discovered non-mutating document, workflow, and insight reads run directly; mutating or destructive tools fail closed.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized capability published by Scribe's current read-only MCP runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, provider permissions, live schemas, bounds, audits, redaction, and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the bounded live-schema wrapper and proxies Scribe OAuth to its hosted MCP.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's dynamically registered confidential PKCE client and exact Railway callback are configured, but no signed-in Enterprise Scribe user was available for production OAuth and MCP acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: An eligible Scribe user clicks Connect, approves the MCP connection, then Relay verifies refresh, health, bounded document search and retrieval, workflow insights, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Scribe documents its hosted MCP at https://mcp.scribe.com/mcp, automatic OAuth, refresh, provider-permission enforcement, document search and retrieval, workflows, insights, cross-source search, expiring screenshot URLs, rate limits, and an organization admin kill switch.
Scribe publishes authorization, token, and dynamic-registration endpoints with authorization-code, refresh-token, S256 PKCE, and confidential client authentication support.
Scribe's separate Enterprise Grid/Global Search API is customer-key and read-only; Relay prefers the official one-click hosted MCP OAuth route instead of requiring this paid-plan key.
Scribe's public OpenAPI describes read-only search, list, retrieve, and team-bound document access, supporting the current non-mutating classification.
